intro.title: Landfall — Azure Migration Estimator
intro.body:
I'm a Microsoft Foundry agent that drafts an Azure landing-zone and migration estimate from a client's on-premises inventory. I run deterministic Azure tools — inventory SQL, VM right-sizing, live retail pricing, CAF landing-zone design, 6R disposition, wave planning — and assemble the results into a traceable estimate you can publish to the dashboard or download as Excel / Word / PowerPoint.

Every figure carries its basis and a confidence rating. Output is a DRAFT for architect review, not a bid. Pick a card below or ask your own question.
capabilities: Inventory & readiness — counts, sizing, OS end-of-support, data-quality gaps
Azure run-rate cost — compute, storage, egress, backup, monitoring; PAYG / reserved / AHB; low–expected–high
Landing zone — management groups, subscriptions, hub-spoke networking, identity, policy, DR
Disposition & waves — 6R per application, risk-ordered migration waves
Deliverables — estimate package, Excel workbook, Word doc, PowerPoint deck, live dashboard
Discovery questionnaire — send the client /questionnaire (or the Word/Excel export); its answers feed the estimate's assumptions

cards.label: Full estimate
cards.prompt: Produce the full migration estimate for this engagement and publish it to the dashboard.

cards.label: Landing zone
cards.prompt: Design the Azure landing zone for this engagement and walk me through the management groups, spokes, identity, connectivity, policy and DR.

cards.label: Landing-zone cost (Calculator POE)
cards.prompt: Build the Azure Pricing Calculator estimate for this engagement's landing zone and target workloads, and publish it to the dashboard as the Proof of Estimate.

cards.label: Run-rate cost
cards.prompt: Break down the Azure run-rate cost with the top cost drivers, the low-expected-high range, the reserved-instance term and the price date.

cards.label: Disposition & waves
cards.prompt: Score the 6R dispositions for every application and build the risk-ordered migration wave plan. Call out the pilot wave and any regulated wave.

cards.label: Right-sizing & compute
cards.prompt: Right-size the servers and estimate the monthly Azure compute cost — quote the SKU mix, the range, and any servers with no performance history.

cards.label: Client deck (PPT)
cards.prompt: Assemble the estimate and generate the PowerPoint assessment deck.

cards.label: Excel workbook
cards.prompt: Generate the Excel workbook with the full calculation appendix and the assumptions register.

cards.label: What's missing?
cards.prompt: What inventory data is missing or low-confidence, and which required discovery-questionnaire questions are still unanswered? Give me the specific list to send the client.

cards.label: Explain a figure
cards.prompt: Explain figure F8 — where did that number come from, which tool produced it, and under what assumptions?
